headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: SC agrees to hear plea on ECI decisions taken by Gyanesh Kumar.
ACB has sought to impound KTR’s passport in Formula E case.
AAP supporters assault Delhi cop during Kejriwal’s Tilak Nagar visit.
Worms in hostel meal trigger students' protest at doon university.
Speaking as ABVP Karyakarta: Telangana CM Revanth appeals to PM.
bullets_ur: SC ne Gyanesh Kumar ke ECI faislon par darkhwast sunne par razamandi zahir ki.
